name: WOMA JETTY
summary: Compact ultra-high-pressure water-jetting robot from the German maker WOMA for hydrodemolition and surface removal on concrete; under 600 kg, it fits through a normal door and can work on scaffolding.

germany.statusNote: German maker (Duisburg) with sales, rental units and a dealer search; the JETTY appears only in a case story, with no product page, data sheet or price.

specs.label: Weight
specs.quote: due to the light weight of less than 600kg it is also suitable to jobs on scaffoldings

specs.label: Access
specs.quote: Thanks to the compact design, the robot fits through a normal door

specs.label: Pump used in the case story
specs.conditions: pump sold separately; one job example
specs.quote: the ultra-high pressure unit EcoMaster MK3 was used. At 2500 bar working pressure and 26 l/min volume flow

specs.label: Jetting tool in the case story
specs.quote: The WOMA TD3000 SCS turbo nozzle is used as a water jetting tool

notes: The page shows the robot with a vertical mast carrying the jetting lance; its running gear is not described, so wheels and tracks are set false.
Needs a separate ultra-high-pressure pump unit (EcoMaster MK3 in the case story).
